findings.finding: Runner retirement and state clearing occurred after terminal audit, and crash reconciliation could perform the same privileged mutation from nominal database-status without an audit result. Current state then diverged from the terminal audit post digest.
findings.required_remediation: Retire exact runners before constructing the normal terminal state and exclude runner identities from its audited poststate. If a crash leaves terminal state with runner identities, make status fail closed and require a mutating audited cleanup transaction.
